title: Implement Focus Session System with Tab Switching Tracking and Progressive Restrictions

requirements.text: Create a focus session setup interface where users can select a session duration (time-based) before starting their focus work, with options for common durations like 25, 45, 60, 90 minutes or custom duration input

quotes: the system determine the important work is complete by the time session selected by the user

acceptanceCriteria: User can select from preset session durations or enter a custom duration
Session timer starts counting down when user begins focus session
Timer displays remaining time clearly throughout the session
User can reset or start a new session when current timer completes

requirements.text: Implement tab switch tracking specifically between productive and distractive content sections within the app, incrementing a violation counter each time user navigates from productive to distractive sections

quotes: if user switches from productive app to distractive app so tab switching counting increasing accordingly

acceptanceCriteria: System detects when user navigates from productive section to distractive section
Violation counter increments only for productive-to-distractive switches, not other navigation
Counter persists throughout the focus session
Counter is visible to user so they can track their violations

requirements.text: Implement a three-strike warning system that applies a grayscale visual effect to distractive content sections for exactly 2 minutes after the third violation (switch to distractive content)

quotes: after the three warning is given by you for the distractive app uses still user use distractive so you have to block or lock that distractive app
warning is given as the screen got grey scale colour for 2 minutes

acceptanceCriteria: After third violation, grayscale effect applies immediately to distractive sections only
Grayscale effect lasts exactly 2 minutes with visible countdown
Productive sections remain in full color during grayscale period
Effect is scoped to distractive content sections, not the entire app interface

requirements.text: After the 2-minute grayscale warning period ends, reset the violation counter to zero and start a new warning cycle, allowing the user to continue with a fresh count

quotes: after two minute give another warning cycle

acceptanceCriteria: Violation counter resets to 0 automatically when 2-minute grayscale period completes
User can again accumulate up to 3 violations before next grayscale period
The cycle repeats indefinitely throughout the focus session
User receives clear indication that counter has reset

requirements.text: Lock and restrict all access to distractive content sections until the user's focus session timer completes, preventing navigation to distractive sections even if user attempts to access them

quotes: you have to block or lock that distractive app till the user important work is not complete
Lock/restrict access to distractive sections until the focus session timer completes

acceptanceCriteria: During active focus session, attempts to navigate to distractive sections are blocked
User sees clear messaging explaining why access is restricted and when it will unlock
Lock remains in effect until session timer reaches zero
Productive sections remain fully accessible during the lock period

requirements.text: When focus session timer completes, automatically lift all restrictions and allow full access to both productive and distractive sections, with option for user to start a new focus session if needed

quotes: When timer ends, work is considered complete and restrictions lift
If user needs more time, they can reset/start a new session

acceptanceCriteria: All locks and restrictions are removed when timer reaches zero
User receives completion notification indicating session is complete
User can freely access all sections after session ends
Clear option is presented to start a new focus session with fresh duration selection

requirements.text: Store focus session data (duration, violations, completion status) in the backend for each completed session to enable historical tracking and analytics
acceptanceCriteria: Each focus session records start time, duration, total violations, and completion status
Data persists in stable storage between canister upgrades
Backend provides query function to retrieve session history
Session data integrates with existing productivity metrics

constraints: Grayscale effect must apply only to distractive content sections, not the entire app
Violation counter only increments for productive-to-distractive navigation, not other switches
Session timer must be user-defined at session start
All restrictions lift automatically when session timer completes
System must work entirely within the web application without external browser control
nonGoals: Blocking browser tabs outside the application
Blocking desktop applications or other websites
Forcing grayscale on productive content sections
Automatic session creation without user initiation
Mobile app development or browser extension functionality
